Decisions change only where a loser was skipped after the plain fallback, which never happened in any recorded run with fallback_factors (0 of 6 runs), so those runs replay unchanged (tests/test_windowed_pbt_v2.py). This record supersedes the earlier entries of the same file. The campaign ran on the frozen files; this record lets later work use the changed file without reporting drift for the completed study.
